_readme: Prompts for tools/lyria_bgm.js (BRIEF Part A10). One entry per BGM id of R.Audio.IDS.bgm.
tempo/key/meter mirror the synth track (src/audio/music*.js) so a generated file can replace it 1:1; `bpm` (optional) is the tempo written into the Lyria prompt when it differs.
The tool builds the English text prompt: style_prompt + desc + tempo/key + instrumentation + form + duration + suffix (edit `prompt` to override one track completely).
Output: assets/bgm/<id>.ogg (ffmpeg present) or .wav, plus <id>.json with the loop points (found automatically: the tool searches the matching bars and bakes a crossfade into the seam).
Never name existing games, composers or songs here: describe the sound in words only.
negative: vocals, singing, lyrics, speech, choir words, crowd noise, vinyl crackle, lo-fi noise, fade-out, modern EDM drops, dubstep, distorted metal guitars, copyrighted melodies

tracks.mood: nostalgic, hopeful, gentle heroism; the storyteller's main theme
tracks.instrumentation: concert harp, solo wooden flute, violins and cellos, french horn, soft timpani, glockenspiel sparkle
tracks.loop: intro of 4 bars then loops the theme
tracks.desc: The main theme of the storyteller hero: nostalgic, hopeful and gently heroic, like opening an old illuminated book at dawn. A soft harp prelude, then a noble, singable flute melody in waltz time; the strings swell in the second half and the theme is restated with fuller orchestra and soft timpani before settling back.
tracks.form: 4-bar harp intro, theme A (flute), theme B (strings and horn), theme A reprise with full orchestra

tracks.mood: adventurous but not too bright, a travelling song, sense of wide open land
tracks.instrumentation: french horns and flute lead, pizzicato and bowed strings, marching snare, light timpani, warm string pads, harp runs
tracks.desc: The world-map travelling song: adventurous and wide open, a sense of walking across green hills toward a far horizon, confident but not bombastic. A heroic horn and flute melody over a bright marching rhythm.
tracks.form: short 2-bar pickup, verse melody, a soaring bridge, return to the verse

tracks.instrumentation: harp arpeggios, flute and oboe melody, violin countermelody, accordion color, light tambourine and bass
tracks.desc: Sailing on a regular passenger ship across an inland sea: carefree lilting 6/8 sea shanty feel, salt breeze and gulls in the imagination, sunlight on waves.
tracks.form: lilting A section, B section with violin countermelody, back to A

tracks.instrumentation: flute and clarinet melody, oboe answer, strummed acoustic guitar, marimba, walking pizzicato bass, shaker and rim clicks
tracks.desc: A lively, friendly market town: bustling stalls, children running, warm afternoon. Bouncy, cheerful and melodic without being childish.
tracks.form: A melody, B melody with clarinet, back to A

tracks.instrumentation: fingerpicked nylon and steel acoustic guitars, pan flute lead, ocarina answer, hand drums and frame drum, soft shaker, rain stick, warm bass drone, light hand-played percussion
tracks.desc: A warm, spiritual canyon village at sunset: red rock walls glowing orange, wind over the mesa, elders telling ancestral stories by the fire. Earthy, nostalgic and deeply peaceful, with a sense of ancient wisdom and belonging. Soft fingerpicked acoustic guitar carries the chords, a breathy pan flute (and an ocarina answering it) sings a simple, heartfelt pentatonic-tinged melody, gentle hand drums keep a relaxed heartbeat groove, with a low warm drone underneath. Wistful, open fifths, a little melancholy but hopeful.
tracks.form: guitar intro phrase, pan flute theme, ocarina answer phrase, theme again with fuller percussion

tracks.instrumentation: trumpet and horn fanfare motifs, harpsichord, timpani, snare ruffs, full strings
tracks.desc: A dignified royal hall: regal and ceremonial, stone pillars and banners, measured and proud.
tracks.form: short fanfare, stately main theme, softer middle with harpsichord, return

tracks.instrumentation: soft wordless choir pad (no words), pipe organ, tubular bells, harp, warm strings, no drums
tracks.desc: A sacred shrine or temple: calm, reverent and luminous, candlelight and incense, time standing still.
tracks.form: slow chorale, gentle harp interlude, chorale again

tracks.scene: エンディング・クレジット
tracks.mood: tender at first, then triumphant and warm, broad closing; reprise of the main theme
tracks.instrumentation: music box and harp opening, solo flute, full orchestra in the middle, strings and horns, gentle timpani, cymbal swells
tracks.loop: plays through; may loop from the middle
tracks.desc: Ending and credits: tender at first, remembering the whole journey, then warm and triumphant, a broad closing statement of the main theme, full of gratitude.
tracks.form: quiet music-box opening, theme on flute, orchestral build, triumphant full restatement, warm coda that can loop back to the theme

tracks.instrumentation: slap electric bass, tight funk drum kit with hi-hat ghost notes, clavinet, muted trumpet and saxophone section stabs, vibraphone, dark electric piano chords
tracks.desc: A stylish underground passage beneath an old city: a cool, sly urban-noir groove in a minor key, like sneaking through the coolest sewer in the world at night. Funky and jazzy, with a slinky slap bass line, tight dry drums with ghost notes, clavinet riffs and short muted brass stabs, a mysterious lead line on muted trumpet or vibraphone. Head-nodding and confident, tension without fear.
tracks.form: bass and drums groove intro, main riff with brass stabs, clavinet break, back to the riff

tracks.instrumentation: walking and slap electric bass, tight dry funk drums, clavinet, brass section stabs, muted trumpet, tenor saxophone, rhodes electric piano, small metallic percussion, dripping echo
tracks.desc: Deep mine tunnels and wet echoing caverns turned impossibly cool: a dark, jazzy urban-noir funk groove in E minor, "the coolest sewer in the world" energy. A deep walking-then-slap bass line locks with tight, crisp drums; staccato brass stabs and a funky clavinet answer each other; a smoky tenor saxophone or muted trumpet plays a sly, memorable minor melody. Dripping water echoes and a hint of metallic percussion like distant pickaxes. Stylish, sneaky, groovy, never scary.
tracks.form: bass groove intro, sax/trumpet theme over the groove, brass and clavinet call-and-response, walking bass break, theme again

tracks.instrumentation: climbing celesta arpeggios, violin melody, ticking rim clicks and woodblock, pizzicato strings, soft pads
tracks.desc: A mysterious tower of lamps and clockwork: rising, curious, a sense of climbing through gears and starlight.
tracks.form: ticking intro, climbing theme, suspended middle, return

tracks.instrumentation: oboe or ney-like reed melody with augmented seconds (phrygian dominant), oud, low drone, darbuka and frame drum, finger cymbals
tracks.desc: An ancient royal tomb in the desert: dry wind, sand hissing on stone, mysterious and exotic, curse and grandeur.
tracks.form: drone and hand drums intro, reed melody, oud interlude, melody returns

tracks.instrumentation: celesta and glockenspiel melody, harp, sleigh-free soft bells, triangle, thin high strings, soft wind pad
tracks.desc: A white-dragon peak in an endless blizzard: crystalline, cold, fragile beauty, glittering snow and silence.
tracks.form: glassy intro, waltz melody, fragile middle, return

tracks.instrumentation: ostinato bass (low strings and synth-like bass), brass stabs, string stabs, pounding toms and taiko, anvil hits
tracks.desc: Inside an active volcano: driving and heavy, heat and danger, lava rumbling, relentless forward motion.
tracks.form: pounding intro, main riff, brass theme, riff returns

tracks.scene: 大書庫（最終ダンジョン）
tracks.instrumentation: pipe organ over a chromatic descending bass, soft wordless choir (no words), gong, low strings, distant bells
tracks.desc: The great archive at the end of the world, being erased into white: dark and grand, ominous, endless shelves of forgotten books and a cathedral-like hush.
tracks.form: organ intro, dark theme, quieter choral middle, theme returns heavier

tracks.instrumentation: bright synth lead doubled with strings, electric bass riff, string stabs, brass hits, driving rock drum kit, timpani accents
tracks.desc: The regular battle theme: energetic, fast and heroic, pumping adrenaline, a catchy lead that the player will hum for years. Driving rock-orchestra hybrid in classic 16-bit JRPG fashion.
tracks.form: 2-bar punchy intro, main riff and melody, a contrasting bridge, back to the main melody

tracks.instrumentation: trumpet and brass melody over a pounding riff, timpani, driving drums, fast string ostinato, electric bass, organ accents
tracks.desc: Boss battle: intense and dramatic, high stakes, a powerful foe; urgency and heroic defiance.
tracks.form: short dramatic intro, riff, brass melody, bridge, melody again

tracks.mood: epic final battle; the main theme in minor, turning major and triumphant in the second half
tracks.instrumentation: pipe organ and wordless choir intro (no words), fast string ostinato, brass, timpani, driving drums, electric bass
tracks.desc: Final battle against the primordial void king: epic and cosmic; the main theme heard in a minor key, then turning major and triumphant near the end of the loop.
tracks.form: organ and choir intro, furious main section, heroic main-theme quote turning major, back to the furious section

tracks.instrumentation: organ, wordless choir (no words), brass, fast strings, heavy drums, harpsichord flourishes
tracks.desc: Battle with the lingering shadow of a legendary demon lord: epic, dark and legendary, gothic grandeur and dread.
tracks.form: short intro, dark riff, brass theme, organ bridge, theme again

tracks.instrumentation: fiddle and tin whistle melody, clarinet, strummed guitar, stomping frame drum (bodhran), upright bass
tracks.desc: A cozy tavern where adventurers gather and companions are recruited: warm firelight, clinking mugs, a foot-tapping jig.
tracks.form: jig A, jig B, back to A

tracks.mood: warm, homely, nostalgic; the main theme softly
tracks.instrumentation: fingerpicked acoustic guitar, ocarina and soft pan flute, music box sparkle, gentle hand drum, warm cello and strings
tracks.desc: The storytellers' home village and the mentor's house: warm, homely and spiritual, sunset light over a quiet valley, the wisdom of generations of storytellers. A gentle, nostalgic fingerpicked acoustic guitar waltz, with a soft ocarina or pan flute softly singing the storyteller's main theme, light hand percussion, and a warm bed of strings. Tender, earthy, safe.
tracks.form: guitar intro, ocarina theme, strings join, quiet return

tracks.mood: sharp, proud, rivalry duel; a falling three-note motif
tracks.instrumentation: sharp solo violin melody, pizzicato strings, snare drum, electric bass, piano stabs, brass accents
tracks.desc: Duel with the proud rival archivist: sharp, proud and fast, a falling three-note motif as his signature, elegant and competitive rather than evil.
tracks.form: intro with the falling three-note motif, violin theme, bridge, theme again

tracks.scene: 緊迫した場面・ラザロ戦
tracks.mood: suspense, urgency, can also drive a battle
tracks.instrumentation: sixteenth-note string ostinato, repeating low bass, long horn notes, clear drum beat, piano pulses
tracks.desc: A tense story scene or the battle with the archive's chief: suspense and urgency, a clock is ticking, a clear driving beat.
tracks.form: ostinato intro, building section, peak, back to the ostinato

tracks.scene: 悲しい場面・ビブリア
tracks.instrumentation: solo oboe and strings, harp arpeggios, soft piano
tracks.desc: A sad scene: quiet, bittersweet memory of someone lost, a lonely melody that still carries warmth.
tracks.form: oboe theme, strings answer, oboe theme again

tracks.mood: heavier and darker than the normal boss theme
tracks.instrumentation: brass chords, chromatic low bass, timpani, driving strings, heavy drums, low choir-like pads
tracks.desc: Regional boss and mid-boss battles: heavier and darker than the normal boss theme, a monstrous presence, menacing but exciting.
tracks.form: heavy intro, riff, brass theme, riff again

tracks.scene: レア魔物・金色の個体
tracks.mood: bright, playful, slightly comic chase ("don't let it escape!")
tracks.instrumentation: glockenspiel and bright pulse-wave style lead, bouncy slap bass, snappy drums, pizzicato strings, xylophone runs
tracks.desc: A rare golden monster appears and will flee at any moment: bright, playful and slightly comic chase music, "don't let it escape!".
tracks.form: quick intro, bouncy theme, sillier middle, theme again

tracks.mood: long epic multi-section battle: prelude, main, quiet middle, climax
tracks.instrumentation: organ, wordless choir (no words), brass, fast strings, heavy drums, gong, electric bass
tracks.desc: Battle with the secret super-boss, an ouroboros dragon of endless stories: a long epic multi-section battle — prelude, relentless main section, a quiet eerie middle, a massive climax.
tracks.form: prelude, main battle section, quiet middle, climax, back to the main section

tracks.scene: 忘却の底（裏ダンジョン）
tracks.instrumentation: hollow pads, reversed-sounding swells, distant bells, slow celesta, sub bass
tracks.desc: The bottom of oblivion, a secret dungeon of forgotten things: hollow, dreamlike, floating in a forgotten void, beautiful and uneasy.
tracks.form: drifting intro, slow motif on celesta, swelling middle, return

tracks.instrumentation: wooden flute and harp, soft hand percussion, marimba droplets, strings, kalimba
tracks.desc: A mystical deep forest and a thousand-year-old tree: gentle wonder, mist between giant trunks, a place that remembers old songs.
tracks.form: harp intro, flute theme, marimba interlude, theme again

tracks.instrumentation: harpsichord and clarinet, slightly broken-sounding music box, distant bell, low strings, soft ghostly pad
tracks.desc: A misty haunted manor, bell-sunken marsh and ghost ship: eerie, haunted and melancholic waltz, candle flames flickering, sad rather than violent.
tracks.form: music-box intro, waltz theme, darker middle, return

tracks.instrumentation: dissonant celesta and bell clusters, low drums, bowed metal textures, deep strings, sub pulses
tracks.desc: The void king reveals itself: unsettling and void-like, a blank page tearing, with brief hushed breaks between phrases that never fully stop the pulse.
tracks.form: eerie intro, pulsing section, hushed break, pulsing section again

tracks.mood: legendary, old tale told by a bard
tracks.instrumentation: music box melody, soft harp, lute, warm low strings
tracks.desc: A legend told by an old bard by the fire: legendary, gentle and warm, the feeling of a timeless tale.
tracks.form: one gentle verse that loops

style_prompt: Instrumental background music for a classic 1990s-style Japanese fantasy role-playing game. The writing and orchestration evoke the golden age of 16-bit console RPG soundtracks (memorable singable lead melody, clear bass line, warm chords, tasteful hall reverb), but the production is high quality, warm and full, recorded with real-sounding instruments. Completely original melody.
suffix: Instrumental only: no vocals, no singing, no spoken words, no lyrics. Keep one steady tempo and key from start to finish, no fade-in and no fade-out, no long silences; the last bar leads naturally back into the first bar so the piece loops seamlessly as game background music.
